sullengard_hadena_0.m: Andor, good timing! Your arrival is much appreciated because I need your help to get my husband home on time today.
r: So, my brother Andor was here as well? I'm $playername and you are?
You must be mistaken. I'm $playername and Andor is my brother, and you are?
I'm sorry because I was only half listening to you earlier, so I am a little fuzzy on the details. But can you explain to me again what you need from me?

sullengard_hadena_1.m:
Oh, I'm sorry. My name is Hadena. Andor used to visit here but I don't know why he doesn't anymore.

Anyways, I really need your help...please.
r: I'm sorry I can't help you right now. I'm busy.

r: What do yo want me to do again with your husband?

sullengard_hadena_7.m: Thank you so much for helping us. You are just like your brother.
r: Of course. He is my brother.

sullengard_hadena_completed.m: Thank you for helping Ainsley and I.
